review: Haute Couture: Le Noir Brand Manager Don Quixote is a Charge-Tremor Identity that focuses on supporting fellow Le Noir Identities with various buffs and effects, and this Identity introduces yet another Tremor type, namely Tremor - Conservation. Let's talk about the new effects first. - Tremor - Conservation - Weaker Tremor - Reverb at first, but once the attacker has enough Charge AND is a Le Noir Identity, then it is stronger. However, without Le Noir Identities bursting Tremor - Conservation, it will be gone very, very fast unless a specific team has been made and piloted, which is not for everybody since if Tremor Burst is triggered by NON Le Noir Identities, additional Count will be consumed. - Promised Nail - Effect inflicted by Haute Couture::Le Noir Brand Manager Don Quixote’s skills. Once per burst, once per skill, it will do, at best, a whopping 10 bonus sloth damage per stack.
